sloka: एतत् ते बल सर्वस्वम् दर्शितम् राक्षसाधम ।शक्ति हीनतरो मत्तो वृथा त्वम् उपगर्जसि ॥३-३०-२॥
transliteration: etat te bala sarvasvam darśitam rākṣasādhama ।śakti hīnataro matto vṛthā tvam upagarjasi ॥3-30-2॥

translations.english: O lowly demon, you have already exhibited all your strength. Inferior to me in energy, you are needlessly roaring.
